scope: Lossless storage of the full diagnostic compilation run index
encoding: dictionary-v1 reports unchanged; internal Float64Array chunks hold exact safe-integer IDs and counts
regressions: Exact event order and every record field survive dictionary expansion.
Adjacent counts and new runs remain exact across a 4096-run chunk boundary.
Mutating a serialized report cannot alter retained run data.
Every serialized entry in the isolated 250000-run measurement is independently checked.
limitations: Memory sample covers retained run storage before JSON report materialization, not total process RSS.
Reports still allocate ordinary JSON tuples; peak serialization memory is not removed.
No compilation is omitted and no capacity increased.
This is not a CI savings measurement.
